description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce" by John Lothrop Motley is a comprehensive historical account written in the late 19th century. The book explores the complex political and military struggles faced by the United Netherlands during a pivotal time following the death of William the Silent, focusing on significant events leading up to the Twelve Years' Truce in 1609.
